# `DISABLE/AUTOFTX`

<div class="command-hero" markdown>

**Suppress FT4/FT8 spots whose comments look automatically generated, while retaining more useful human-entered FT4/FT8 spots.**

## Built-in help (secondary)

This section comes from `Commands_en.hlp` and may lag the implementation.

```text
DISABLE/AUTOFTX
```

**Disable Autogenerated FT4/8 spots**

## When would I use this?

Useful when you want FT4/FT8 activity but do not want repetitive machine-generated signal-report comments.

## Practical examples

### Keep FT4/FT8 enabled but suppress autogenerated comments

```text
ENABLE/FTX
DISABLE/AUTOFTX
```

### Restore autogenerated FT4/FT8 spots

```text
ENABLE/AUTOFTX
```
